The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of mild hyperammonemic and inappropriately high insulin levels in patients with hypoglycaemic symptoms and seizures should raise the suspicion of hyperinsulinemia-hyperammonaemia syndrome.
hyperammonemia is an important feature of hyperinsulinemia caused by a GLUD1 gene mutation and should not be ignored.
